entries.subject: Placement

(2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 81937: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 41.99 +/- 0.16 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101): 23.815 +/- 0.091 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 42.0904 +/- 0.1616 mas (same row, RUWE 3.62), 260.4 standard errors, is not used. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature

Mass 1.824 +/- 0.016 solar masses from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 81937: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.824 +/- 0.016 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101). Temperature 6693 +/- 45 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 81937: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6693 +/- 45.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 539: HR 3757; VizieR III/202, cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 1064092789129355136 (6 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #dee4ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 81937 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 3757 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 3757 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 3757 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,693 K and log g 3.77 (u1 0.334, u2 0.321): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
